descriptionChirho: The proper name Gedalyahu (Gedaliah), referring to several biblical figures including the governor of Judah appointed by Nebuchadnezzar after Jerusalem's fall (2 Kings 25, Jer 39-41). All 26 occurrences denote the same personal name across grammatical contexts: bare citation (eng: Gedalyahu, spa: Gedalias, hin: गदल्याहू, arb: جَدَلْيَاهُو, kor: 게달리야, swa: Gedaliya) and conjunctive form with waw-prefix (eng: and-Gedalyahu, spa: y-Gedalyahu, arb: وَ–جَدَلْيَا). The name means 'YHWH is great.'
